method: Double precision full-line Moller-Trumbore intersections with all raw STL triangles; duplicate crossings within 1e-5 mm coalesced; successive pairs are solid intervals. Noncoplanar generic sample lines, no mesh repair. Rows record original STL face indices. Entire line origin is variable-zero; negative t allowed.
scope: Old fixed candidate only; SHA-256 must match 9c90c8b6b6f99076f2096783e78b793404fb81df88ee270d2eb02f21290e24b8. Live model.stl may be edited independently.
reproduction_usage: Extract reproduction_python to a temporary .py; run Python script --stl <fixed-input.stl> --output <new-report.json>. Use a new output path to preserve old evidence; --output is mandatory.
